title: epipactis helleborine f. alba
intro: Epipactis helleborine f. alba, commonly known as the white helleborine, is a rare and endangered orchid species native to Europe and Asia. It is known for its unique white flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from harm. The bioactive constituents of Epipactis helleborine f. alba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
